flyer.justification: The flyer captures the core message and logistics well, though the title exceeds the 6-word maximum limit.

linkedin.justification: The post is well structured with clean takeaways, strong narrative flow, and adheres strictly to formatting and forbidden word constraints.

summary.justification: The briefing is concise, under 400 words, and accurately presents key metrics, discussion points, and action items.

instagram.justification: The caption includes visual carousel prompts, engaging formatting with emojis, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter is conversational with three distinct sections, but the subject line exceeds the 50-character limit.

blog.justification: The long-form article follows all structural instructions, including numbered sections, a comparative table, and an author bio.
